chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Ali ibn Abi Hamza, from Abu Baseer, who said:

I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a group of people who bought a hunted prey. A female companion of theirs said to them, 'Make a share for me in it for one Dirham.' So they made it for her. He (peace be upon him) said: 'Upon each person from them is a ransom.'

key_terms.إِحْرَامٌ: State of consecration for Hajj or Umrah

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on buying hunted prey for a companion while in Ihram?
ai.summary: This narration from *Al-Kafi* clarifies the mechanism of *fidyah* (ransom) in communal hunting, establishing that the liability for ransom attaches to each individual who acquires a share of the prey, regardless of whether they personally hunted it. Scholarly commentary highlights that this ruling applies even if the recipient is not in *Ihram*, emphasizing that the act of purchasing and securing a share constitutes the basis for the obligation. It underscores the principle that the prohibition of hunting extends to the acquisition and consumption of the game by those in the sacred state.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr, from Ali Bin Abu Hamza, from Abu Baseer who said,

‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about a group of people who are buying a hunted prey. So a female friend of theirs says to them, ‘Make (part of it) to be for me, regarding one Dirham’. So they make it to be for her. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Upon each person from them, is a ransom’.
en.sarwar: 4. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn abu Nasr from Ali ibn abu Hamzah who has said the following: “

I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the case of a people who buy an animal which is hunted, and one of their female companions ask them to leave for her something thereof for a dirham. He (the Imam) said, ‘Every human being of them owes a ransom.’”
